opportunity.title: Mini Video Content Package for Small Businesses
opportunity.target_customer: Small businesses looking to enhance their social media presence on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
opportunity.customer_problem: Small businesses often lack the time, expertise, and resources to create engaging short-form video content that resonates with their audience and boosts visibility.
opportunity.proposed_solution: Offer a Mini Video Content Package that includes scriptwriting, short-form video ideas, captions, and a social media strategy tailored to their brand, enabling small businesses to efficiently create engaging content.
deliverables: Three custom script templates for short-form videos
Two captivating video ideas tailored to brand identity
Five pre-written captions optimized for engagement
A simple, effective social media strategy guide for posting on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
opportunity.next_action: Create a promotional listing detailing the service and its benefits for potential customers.
